title: CR-007 Porcelain Echo
description: Source-backed V3.4 artifact transformation: translate the verified CR-002 Song Corridor Editorial photograph into contemporary handcrafted porcelain vessel decoration with recognizable figurative underglaze painting. Uses portrait_to_decorated_artifact + blue_white_ceramic + vase + newly_created. Symbolic reference roles only; binary reference packaging is out of PromptRecipe scope. Operator must supply the verified CR-002 PNG (SHA-256 a457c47cd96633b18d69e218f3316edb9886ea58114b96f2b4c0d1dce18221e0) as the image input at generation time. See docs/CR_007_PORCELAIN_ECHO.md. No gallery image attached.

semantic_spec.request: Transform the referenced adult fashion photograph into cobalt underglaze figurative decoration physically integrated with one contemporary free-standing porcelain vase, photographed in a controlled gallery or product-photography setting. Preserve recognizable visual identity of the source adult figure: general facial structure and gaze orientation, restrained upswept hairstyle with floral hair ornament, layered pale clothing arrangement and major sleeve/drapery relationships, and the distinctive silhouette—translated into brush-painted ceramic design rather than a living person. The decoration must wrap the vessel's curved surface across neck, shoulder, and belly zones with foreshortening that respects three-dimensional geometry. The result must read as one finished ceramic art vessel—not a flat portrait, framed painting, poster, free-standing stone figure, wall painting installation, living figure standing beside or inside the vase, or a rectangular photo pasted onto ceramic. Do not present the object as an authenticated Song-dynasty artifact, excavated antiquity, or branded commercial product. Keep a pale ivory porcelain body, cobalt indigo underglaze with reserved white ground, thin transparent glaze whose specular highlights sit above the painted pigment, a believable rim opening and foot, coherent base contact, and quiet studio lighting.
